generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The added assertion `assert ThreadPool.assertCurrentThreadPool(Names.CLUSTER_COORDINATION);` is redundant because the same assertion already exists at the beginning of the method `handlePublishRequest`. This duplication can be removed to avoid unnecessary checks and maintain cleaner code.

review_comment: This is probably controversial, but by factoring out the `deserialiseAndApplyDiff`, incomingState can be made final and used directly in the runBefore lambda. Git also appears to retain the history for the body of `deserialiseAndApply` nicely.
Nope seems fine to me, nice idea.
